grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: Family Photos and Things We Have
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方考试。听录音前先看题。录音会播放两遍。每题只选一个答案或填一个词。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Tom: Hi, Lily. Are these your family photos?
Lily: Yes, they are. This is my mother and this is my father.
Tom: And who is this? Is she your sister?
Lily: No, she is not my sister. She is my aunt. Her name is Anna.
Tom: Does she have children?
Lily: Yes, she has two children.
Tom: And these two boys? Are they your brothers?
Lily: No, they are not my brothers. They are my cousins.
Tom: Do you have brothers or sisters?
Lily: I have one brother and two sisters. We are five in my family.
Tom: Do they have a car?
Lily: No, they do not have a car. They have a new table.

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 我们用 we 表示“我们”，用 they 表示“他们/她们/它们”。we 和 they 后面用 are。名词变复数时，一般加 -s，例如 sister → sisters，brother → brothers。my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的/你们的”，his 表示“他的”，her 表示“她的”。have 表示“有”，当主语是 he、she、it 或一个人时，用 has。
grammar.example: My brother and my sisters have a computer.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，be 动词用 are。
questions.evidence: We are five in my family.

questions.explanation: 主语是 they，be 动词用 are。
主语是 she，表示“有”用 has。

questions.explanation: sister 是女性，表示“她的”用 Her。
